card.name: Quantity words before 'number' or 'percentage'
card.fires_on: Size words like small, greater, higher, significant, or the article 'a', right before an expected 'number', 'proportion', 'percentage' or 'fraction' of patients or users.

modes.label: Significantly higher risk
modes.description: A comparative after 'significantly' in an incidence comparison.
